critiques.notes: This is an endearing pet portrait with good composition and a joyful expression. The primary challenges are soft focus and slightly overexposed white fur that loses texture. Targeted sharpening on key features and highlight recovery will significantly improve the image while maintaining its warm, friendly character. The soft focus appears to be from camera settings rather than artistic intent, so selective sharpening is appropriate.

improvements_detailed.action: Apply targeted sharpening to the eyes and nose using unsharp mask (Amount: 80-100, Radius: 1.0, Threshold: 3)
improvements_detailed.reason: The overall softness detracts from the portrait; sharpening the key features (eyes, nose) will create a more engaging focal point while working within the existing soft aesthetic

improvements_detailed.action: Reduce highlights by -15 to -25, particularly in the white fur areas on the head and chest to recover texture and dimension
improvements_detailed.reason: The bright white fur is slightly blown out, losing detail and making the dog appear flat; recovering these highlights will add depth and showcase the fluffy texture

improvements_detailed.action: Increase clarity/texture slider by +10 to +15 selectively on the fur to enhance definition without over-sharpening
improvements_detailed.reason: Adding subtle texture will help define the individual fur strands and create more visual interest in the coat while maintaining the soft, friendly feel

improvements_detailed.action: Apply slight vignette (feather: 70-80, amount: -5 to -10) to draw attention to the dog's face
improvements_detailed.reason: The blurred background plants compete slightly for attention; a gentle vignette will naturally guide the viewer's eye to the subject's expressive face

improvements_detailed.action: Adjust white balance cooler by reducing temperature -200 to -300K to achieve more neutral whites in the fur
improvements_detailed.reason: The warm cast makes the white fur appear slightly cream or yellow; cooler adjustment will render the fur more true-to-life while maintaining natural skin tones on the nose and tongue

improvements_detailed.action: Lift overall exposure slightly (+0.2 to +0.4 EV) and raise shadows on the fur (+15 to +25) while keeping blacks anchored (-5 to -10) to maintain depth
improvements_detailed.reason: Brightens the white fur and reveals texture without washing out contrast around the nose/mouth.

improvements_detailed.action: Reduce noise (Luminance NR ~25–40, Color NR ~20–30) and then apply careful masking-based sharpening (Amount ~40–60, Masking ~70–90) targeting eyes/nose
improvements_detailed.reason: The image shows visible grain in the midtones; controlling noise while sharpening only key features improves perceived clarity without making the fur crunchy.

improvements_detailed.action: Cool white balance slightly (Temp -200 to -500K) and add a small magenta shift (+2 to +6) to neutralize yellow/green cast in the whites
improvements_detailed.reason: Cleaner whites in the fur make the subject look fresher and more natural while keeping the warm, cozy indoor feel.

improvements_detailed.action: Local adjustments: add subtle eye enhancement (small radial mask with +0.2 exposure, +10 clarity/texture) and reduce highlights on the snout/fur hotspots (Highlights -10 to -20)
improvements_detailed.reason: Draws attention to the eyes and balances bright areas so the face reads more clearly.

improvements_detailed.action: Crop slightly tighter from the top/edges and add a gentle vignette (-8 to -15) centered on the face
improvements_detailed.reason: Minimizes background distraction and strengthens focus on the dog’s expression.
